title: Shared Roster
description: build_teams(assignments) takes [person, team] pairs and returns a dictionary mapping each team name to its members, in order. Everyone ends up on every team.
hint: Where does `members` live: on each Team object, or on the Team class itself?
explanation: `members = []` in the class body creates one class attribute shared by every instance and by every call. `self.members.append` finds that shared list. Create per-instance state in `__init__` with `self.members = []`.
